settings.sch_card_body: Five pathways from a single lesson to a multi-day programme — teacher-friendly, hand tools only, OCN London Level 2 accredited when you build up.
settings.comc_card_body: The same five pathways in youth settings — a free taster talk to accredited builds and enterprise skills. Delivered with Project Zero in Waltham Forest; piloted with Camden.
settings.mat_lede: Bamboo is harvested in years, not decades — no welding, no factory. A regenerative material that makes sustainable design tangible, and simple enough to work with hand tools in any classroom.
settings.mat1_b: Bamboo regrows in three to five years. Building with it makes sustainable design something students can hold, cut and shape.
settings.mat2_b: A hacksaw, files, sandpaper and a tape measure. Simple tools make real engineering accessible to every young person in the room.
settings.mat3_b: Working the material teaches engineering, design and sustainability at the same time — a real option, not a topic.
settings.mat_range: bamboo speaker, balance bike, road & gravel frame, e-bike, 3D-printed components, bespoke frames
settings.pw_lede: Start with a talk, climb to digital fabrication. Every pathway runs on the same bench skills — in schools, colleges and youth settings alike — and each one opens below with cohort, format, duration and what gets built.
settings.pw_note: Every pathway is quoted on cohort size and delivery format. A taster talk in your venue is free — book one and see the material in the room.
settings.sch_title: from one lesson to a five-day programme.
settings.sch_lede: Every pathway fits a school format — a single period, a double, a half day, a drop-down day or a multi-day programme. Teachers stay in the room; we bring the tools, the material and the plan.
settings.tt_title: flexible delivery around the school timetable.
settings.tt_lede: Pick the slot you have and we fit the pathway to it. "Make & Take" is the speaker session — the make-and-take product.
settings.tt_foot: From a single lesson to a full STEM day or an intensive programme.
settings.com_lede: The same five pathways, in youth settings — start with a free taster talk in your venue, and go as far as your young people want. Practical learning built for councils, violence reduction units, youth hubs, PRUs and community trusts.
settings.com_audiences: councils, violence reduction units, youth hubs, PRUs, community trusts
settings.com_proof: Delivered with Project Zero and Waltham Forest College — 27 young people built working bamboo bikes, and their ratings regularly reached 9–10 out of 10. Piloted with Camden at Euston Skills Centre.
